text: Hallelu YAH! Sing to YHWH a new song—His praise in the assembly of the holy ones!
Let Israel rejoice in his Maker; let the sons of Zion rejoice in their King!
Let them praise His name with dancing; with tambourine and harp let them make music to Him!
For YHWH delights in His people; He adorns the humble with salvation.
Let the holy ones exult in [His] glory; let them sing for joy upon their beds.
Let the high praises of God [be] in their throat, and a two-edged sword in their hand,
to execute vengeance on the nations, and punishments against the peoples,
to bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with shackles of iron,
to execute against them the judgment written—it [is] an honor for all His holy ones. Praise YAH!
